0d23cd6a05ee5a5c0979d06d8a62356e74ef7972.sourceText: 那么问题是：这一块代码是如何区分那个对象调用自己的呢？
0d23cd6a05ee5a5c0979d06d8a62356e74ef7972.translatedText: So the question is: how does this piece of code distinguish which object is calling it?

0d6a8f023a5d206dd5f253b2bae4c8a4896bb4b8.sourceText: > 总结：与while循环区别在于，do...while先执行一次循环语句，再判断循环条件
0d6a8f023a5d206dd5f253b2bae4c8a4896bb4b8.translatedText: > Summary: The difference from a while loop is that do\.\.\.while executes the loop body once first, and then evaluates the loop condition\.

0d7bf62254d4c45152c2696d22c350fd38c466ff.sourceText: ​		由程序员分配释放,若程序员不释放,程序结束时由操作系统回收
0d7bf62254d4c45152c2696d22c350fd38c466ff.translatedText: ​		Allocated and freed by the programmer; if the programmer does not free it, the operating system reclaims it when the program terminates\.
